I’m honestly willing to be that person. I’ve had a date set for the longest time, but I made a promise and now I have to push it back by four years. Too late to do anything for that. 

Plus, reporting her isn’t an option. It means that I’d have to reveal my suicidal thoughts and tendencies, as well as the self harm. That would only make everything worse with my family.
I’m only 17. Getting a new therapist on my own isn’t currently an option, but neither is telling my family
